prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 6 tests with 2 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.0% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive pet personality selector redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen into a stage layout with interactive emotion animations and instant trait feedback when selecting pets. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a high mean completion time of 1017s.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Centered path option showcase redesign: Redesigns the path choice screen into a centered presentation highlighting clear benefits for quick start vs custom pet creation. (why: The choose_path step sees a 23.8% dropoff rate (76.2% conversion) and a very high mean time of 514s due to decision hesitation.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop engine launch readiness status indicator: Displays a real-time engine startup checklist on the waiting screen showing pet asset compilation and desktop integration status. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), and support received 3 emails about pets failing to show or app stalling.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet sync reassurance notice: Adds prominent sync reassurance text on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets will be safely restored upon logging in. (why: Support received 8 emails—the largest issue category—about pets missing or resetting after users signed in again.)
4: [finish, layout] Stage layout setup completion overview: Updates home_intro to a stage layout featuring a live desktop pet animation and immediate launch action. (why: Finish conversion drops to 71.0% with an extreme mean duration of 5815s. Historical data confirms finish redesigns average +1.2% lift.)
5: [home, notification] Background adoption completion alert system: Adds an optional background notification setting on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), indicating users switch to other tasks while waiting and lose context.)
